steps.text: Soften the onion and bell peppers in olive oil.
Add garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and a pinch of chili flakes; stir.
Add the tomatoes, crush them in the pan, and simmer until thick.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook until the whites set.
Rest, then serve in the skillet.

summary: Eggs poached in a smoky, cumin-spiced tomato and pepper sauce, straight from the skillet.
title: Shakshuka

steps.text: Soften onion and carrots in oil.
Add garlic, turmeric, and cumin; stir.
Add rinsed red lentils and 1.2 L water; simmer.
Blend half the soup and stir it back in for body.
Finish with lemon juice and salt; rest before serving.

summary: A turmeric-gold soup that turns the carrots and onion you have into the best thing on this list, for the price of lentils and a lemon.
title: Golden Carrot & Lentil Soup
